'''Star Tours Flight 822''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at Gate 1L, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival at 1315 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1410.
